author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the second trailer in the three-part trailer series for Anno 117: Pax Romana’s second DLC, The Hippodrome. The new trailer showcases the new chariot races event coming as part of the DLC for the strategy game. In The Hippodrome DLC, once you finish building Latium’s largest monument, you’ll have access to an exclusive new event: chariot races! Gather resources and host thrilling spectacles to satisfy your citizens’ hunger for entertainment. The racetrack is where legends are made and ordinary Specialists transform into unexpected heroes. Any Specialist can race, from a seasoned Roman veteran to the humble baker—who will you select to be your driver?


In Anno 117: Pax Romana, it’s your destiny to shape the Roman Empire in the year 117 AD. As governor, will you encourage economic growth or expand your rule through dominance? Lead with rebellion or unite a diverse culture? The cost of peace is yours to decide.
title: Anno 117: Pax Romana - The Hippodrome Part Two Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
The Alters: Last Variable is available now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S. Watch The Alters: Last Variable launch trailer for this expansion to the sci-fi survival adventure game. 

Jan Dolski's mission didn't end when the credits rolled on The Alters. Well, perhaps more to the point, Jan Scientist's mission didn’t end. In this powerful new storyline, packed with new mechanics, new Alter types, and more, players will assist this particular version of Jan in conducting the research of a lifetime. 

The Oasis - a lush paradise emerging from desolation - becomes Jan's obsession. One he cannot comprehend alone. So once again, he must assemble a crew from alternate versions of himself. A Geologist. A Biologist. A Chemist. A Physicist. 

Science is everything for these Jans. But can we really understand everything?
title: The Alters: Last Variable - Official Launch Trailer
